balance.verdict: CORPUS_DEFECT — the gate is RIGHT, do NOT recalibrate it
balance.decisive_evidence: The domain is NOT single-dominant at the graph level. In the triples, in_lineup is the MAJORITY predicate at 60.9% and plays_at is 34.7% — two comparably-sized relations. The skew appears only in generated surfaces, where artist_to_stage is 84.9%. Amplification per fact: artist_to_stage 565660 surfaces against plays_at's 13026 triples is ~43 surfaces per fact; in_lineup is 45482 against 22846 triples, ~2.0 surfaces per fact. That is a ~21x asymmetry in how many phrasings the generator emits per fact, not a property of what a festival lineup IS.
balance.why_hypothesis_a_fails: The gate-misfit story requires the domain itself to be single-dominant so that a correct corpus trips a wrongly-shaped gate. The triple distribution falsifies that directly: the graph's dominant relation (in_lineup, 60.9%) is NOT the one that dominates the surfaces (artist_to_stage, 84.9%). A gate recalibration here would have raised dominance_max_frac until a generator imbalance became invisible — the exact silent-threshold-bump this campaign forbids.
balance.prescribed_fix: Rebalance surface GENERATION, not the gate. dominance_max_frac / balance_cov_max stay untouched (cov_max remains 1.0). The lever is the per-template emission budget in the hydrate/synth path so surfaces-per-fact is comparable across template families.

disjoint_static.decisive_evidence: Every sampled violation is a single-fact positive statement naming ONE stage, so it cannot be a two-confusable co-mention (hypothesis b), and it contains no comparative construction such as 'X leads A, while Y leads B' (hypothesis a). What they share is the EDITION: the confusable groups pin Armin van Buuren to kineticFIELD/Sunday for las_vegas/2026, while the flagged surfaces describe las_vegas/2016, where circuitGROUNDS is the factually correct stage. The gate is applying one edition's confusable pins to a corpus spanning 97 editions from 1997 to 2026.
disjoint_static.prescribed_fix: Scope confusable-group enforcement to the edition that DEFINED the group. A surface from las_vegas/2016 must not be judged against las_vegas/2026's pins. Required red-greens before it lands: (RED, must still FAIL) a las_vegas/2026 surface placing Armin at a stage other than kineticFIELD, and a genuine two-confusable positive co-mention; (GREEN, must PASS) the 2016 surfaces above, which are true for their own edition.
disjoint_static.explicitly_not_done: This is NOT a threshold change and must not be implemented as one. Narrowing the check's scope without the RED cases above would disarm the disjoint-context law instead of correcting it, so it is left unimplemented rather than rushed.
